title_original: 선거관리위원회보안관리대 설치 및 운영에 관한 규칙
full_text:
Article 3 (Organization)
(1) A Security Management Unit shall consist of an overall officer in charge and security management personnel.
(2) The overall officer in charge shall be the head of the department responsible for the affairs of the Security Management Unit.
(3) Under the direction of the head of the agency in which a Security Management Unit has been established pursuant to Article 2 (hereinafter referred to as the "establishing agency"), the overall officer in charge shall operate the Security Management Unit.
(4) Security management personnel shall consist of public officials of the establishing agency and persons working for that agency pursuant to statutes, regulations or contracts.
(5) The head of an establishing agency may designate an on-site manager, such as the head of the Security Management Unit, from among security management personnel to assist the overall officer in charge in performing duties.
